slides.title: Free designers [don't make] a free rebrand.
slides.lede: Before you keep it in-house, test capacity, challenge and who owns the rollout.

slides.title: Write the brief [before] judging the team
slides.text: Updating proposal templates is a different job from deciding how an acquired consultancy fits beneath the parent brand. "New identity" is too vague to expose a gap.

slides.title: Name who owns [each stage]
slides.note: Then ask what each person will **stop doing**. If nothing gives way, the rebrand has no protected time.

cards.label: In-house
cards.text: 160 internal hours at £50 an hour: £8,000 of staff cost.

cards.label: Agency-led
cards.text: £12,000 quote plus 40 internal hours: £14,000 before exclusions.

slides.quote: What finding would make us reject the preferred positioning?
slides.text: If the honest answer is "nothing", the exercise is confirmation. An agency doesn't fix that either: it needs the same access and permission.

items.title: Research
items.text: Agency leads; your sponsor arranges access.

items.title: Launch
items.text: Internal owner coordinates staff and clients.
